title: The Iron Orchard
author: Sable Joubert
blurb: Lior Thackeray, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, has spent twelve years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
